Lena (docs): Heads up — PR #1289 for the action-hooks docs just merged but CI flagged the SDK snippet mismatch. Anyone on deck to patch the examples?
Ben (eng): I saw that. The JS snippet uses the old `callTool` shape, our SDK now expects `invokeAction` with an `action` envelope. Quick patch should be fine.
Emma (devex): @Ben can you paste the corrected snippet here? I can land the docs tweak + run a linkcheck.
Ben (eng): Sure — replace the body with this pattern:
```js
const res = await client.invokeAction({
  action: { name: 'email.send', args: { to: 'user@example.com', subject: 'Hi' } },
  mode: 'sync'
});
// res.output -> { status: 'ok', result: { id: 'abc123' } }
```
Sasha (eng-ml): Also note the JSON schema in the docs still shows `result` as nullable. For action-hooks we standardized on `result` required and `error` optional. Need to update the schema block and the example response.
Lena (docs): Good catch. I will update the schema snippet to reflect required `result`. Any objections to adding a short guardrail note about never relying on `args` ordering?
Ben (eng): No objections. Maybe add a tiny note about using `action.name` as the routing key — ops rely on that.
Emma (devex): I'll also add a Python side-by-side snippet. Proposed python example: 
```py
res = client.invoke_action({
  "action": {"name": "email.send", "args": {"to": "user@example.com", "subject": "Hi"}},
  "mode": "sync"
})
# res['output'] -> { 'status': 'ok', 'result': { 'id': 'abc123' } }
```
Lena (docs): Thx. One more: the CI link-checker reported a broken anchor for `#action-response-shape` (internal heading) — link is in the migration guide. I can fix the anchor but need someone to confirm exact heading text.
docs-ci-bot: check-link(https://docs.redwood.ai/action-hooks#migration) -> 404 anchor not found.
Sasha (eng-ml): The heading was renamed to "Action response shape and guardrails" in earlier PR. Anchor should be `#action-response-shape-and-guardrails`. Update the link.
Lena (docs): Perfect — I'll push a tiny follow-up PR that: updates the JS/Python snippets to `invokeAction/invoke_action`, patches the JSON schema to mark `result` required, adds the guardrail note, and fixes the anchor.
Ben (eng): If you want I can add a unit test snippet referencing the shape so it stays correct — small Jest example asserting `res.output.result.id`.
Emma (devex): That would be great. Also pinging @Sasha to sanity-check the schema wording before merge.
Sasha (eng-ml): Happy to review. I'll do a quick pass after you open the PR.
Lena (docs): Opening follow-up as #1292 in a few mins. Will drop the PR link here.
Lena (docs): PR #1292: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1292 : will merge after Sasha sign-off and CI green. :rocket:
Ben (eng): LGTM once tests added.
Emma (devex): I'll run linkcheck locally quick.
Sasha (eng-ml): Reviewing now, small nit on wording for the guardrail (suggest rephrase to "treat `error` as canonical failure indicator").
Lena (docs): Thanks — changed and force-pushed. CI requeued.
docs-ci-bot: PR #1292 — ci/linkcheck — passed.
Ben (eng): Merged. :tada:
Lena (docs): Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll sweep the rest of the migration guide for other old shapes this afternoon. If you see other broken anchors or obsolete snippets, drop them here.
Emma (devex): Adding a follow-up task in the docs backlog to audit examples across SDKs. :memo:
